description: This file defines SwiftUI views related to gateway discovery, including a list view (`GatewayDiscoveryInlineList`) and a menu view (`GatewayDiscoveryMenu`) for displaying discovered gateways, their statuses, and handling user interaction.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryInlineList
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays a list of gateway discoveries, allowing user selection and hover interactions.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryMenu
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays a menu of discovered gateways for user selection.

methods.name: displayInfo
methods.description: Determines display label and selection state based on the transport type and current URL/target.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a given string.
